rationale: The run started from the homepage (https://www.moncler.com/en-gb/) which is not a PLP and is often blocked by a cookie/region gate, so no product tiles appeared. We prioritize non-code fixes: (1) start directly on a stable PLP-like search results page, (2) add cookie consent handling for OneTrust, (3) wait for robust grid selectors, and (4) normalize/redirect URLs to enforce en-gb and avoid homepage/brand-corporate traps. Minimal selector fallbacks are added for PLP tiles and PDP title/price to improve resilience without breaking existing keys.

traps.reason: Homepage is not a PLP; go to a stable search PLP.

code_hints: - Immediately check for and click OneTrust cookie button (#onetrust-accept-btn-handler) if present before any navigation waits.

- If you still land on the homepage after normalization, open site search: click header search button (button[aria-label*='Search' i] or [data-test='open-search']) and submit 'jackets', then wait for [data-test='product-grid'] or .product-grid.
- Consider PLP tiles as any link under the grid that ends with .html and is not a category (?cgid) link; de-duplicate by pathname.
- After navigating to PLP, perform 2-3 incremental scrolls (1200px step, ~800ms wait) to ensure lazy tiles render.
- PDP extraction: prefer visible selectors first; if price not visible, parse application/ld+json for offers.price/currency as fallback.
- Guard against locale/region gate: if a modal contains 'United Kingdom' or 'Stay on current site', click the primary button to continue.
- Ensure final URLs stay on https://www.moncler.com/en-gb/ and reject redirects to monclergroup.com or storelocator.
